name: run_destvi_deconvolution
description: Deconvolve a spatial transcriptomics slide with DestVI (Lopez 2022 / scvi-tools, Gayoso 2022). Trains a CondSCVI model on an annotated single-cell RNA-seq reference (cells labelled by cell type), then fits DestVI on the spatial data to estimate, per spot, the proportion of each cell type. Returns per-cell-type mean proportions across spots. Inputs are server-accessible .h5ad files of raw counts.

sc_path.description: Server-accessible path or URL to the single-cell reference .h5ad of RAW counts, annotated with `cluster_label` in obs.

sp_path.description: Server-accessible path or URL to the spatial transcriptomics .h5ad of RAW counts (spots x genes).

cluster_label.description: obs column in the single-cell reference naming the cell-type label used as deconvolution targets (e.g. 'cell_type').

sc_epochs.description: Training epochs for the CondSCVI reference model (default 100).

st_epochs.description: Training epochs for the DestVI spatial model (default 500).

cell_types.description: Cell-type names deconvolved from the single-cell reference.

mean_proportions.description: Mean DestVI-estimated proportion per cell type across all spots.

error.description: Error description if the run failed.
